name: My Dream Date with the Yandere Serial Killer
source:
Richard Ramirez... 
Charles Manson...
Ted Bundy...
What do these three men have in common?

They were bloodthirsty, cruel serial killers, who failed to value human life and-

this girl is Yanette. She has an unhealthy fascination for serial killers and her dream is to date one. 

So, when she finds out there is one in her city, she invites the sexy and mysterious Yancie on a date at her place.

Now, all she has to do is gain his heart and seduce him! It's not as if anything could go wrong!

理查德·拉米雷斯… 
查尔斯·曼森…
特德·邦迪…
这三个人有什么共同点？

他们是嗜血、残忍的连环杀手，不重视人的生命，而且——

这个女孩就是雅内特。她对连环杀手有一种不健康的迷恋，她的梦想是与连环杀手约会。

因此，当她发现自己的城市里有这样的人时，她邀请性感而神秘的Yancie到她家约会。

现在，她要做的，就是俘获他的心，勾引他！好像不会出什么差错吧！
